items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I was in the office with him this night... I said, 'If she was my wife, I'd get the ring...'

ctx.x: You were mentioning off the tape yesterday, that you knew Kay Starr and was it? From recording, and you introduced her to Hal Stanley, whom she married, and Hal Stanley, you were telling me all the different clubs that Hal Stanley operated. What were they?
Yeah. Hal Stanley operated the Rum
Boogie, up on Highland Blvd., that's where C.P. Johnson was, and I still think that at one time they had another club there that he called the Onyx Club.
